Meet Dr. Neda Moezzi, DDS

Hello, I’m Dr. Moezzi. To me, dentistry is about more than just treating teeth-it’s about building trust and forming real connections. I make it a priority to give every patient my full attention at every appointment, taking the time to listen, understand your goals, and create a plan that supports your long-term health and well-being. I graduated from the University of Detroit Mercy Dental School in 2010, and since then, l’ve continued to expand my skills in both general and advanced dentistry as one of the most sought-after dentists in Santa Clarita, CA. My ultimate goal is to make sure you feel comfortable, informed, and genuinely cared for—every step of the way. I look forward to meeting you.

Frequently Asked Questions

items.title: What makes Valencia Smile Expert different?

children.html: We offer holistic, personalized dental care that considers your overall health—not just your teeth. Our experts provides one-on-one attention in a calm, supportive environment.

items.title: Do you offer cosmetic services like veneers or Invisalign?

children.html: Absolutely. We offer veneers, teeth whitening, and Invisalign—all customized to your unique smile.

items.title: What happens during my first visit?

children.html: We’ll review your health history, complete an exam, and take time to understand your goals.

items.title: Can I get a crown in one visit?

children.html: Yes. We offer in-house custom crowns, so many patients receive theirs the same day.

items.title: Where are you located, and is there parking?

children.html: We’re in West Hollywood with nearby parking and easy elevator access.
